dotcom07 opened PR #14522 from dotcom07:fix/ieee-float-zero-comparison to bytecodealliance:main:

Ieee16::partial_cmp and Ieee128::partial_cmp return Equal whenever either operand is zero. This makes the interpreter report that 1 == 0 and that 1 > 0 is false. Require both operands to be zero for the special case, preserving equality between positive and negative zero.

Adds unit tests for both types covering signed zeros, positive and negative one, and the smallest positive and negative subnormals, with operands in both orders.

Tested with cargo +1.97.0 test -p cranelift-codegen --lib --offline (214 tests passed).
